claims.text: IPA systems label data by accumulating structured and labeled dialogues during user interactions, which are stored in a structured form for further training.
The system collects information from user interactions, which helps in creating labeled datasets that can be used for training dialogue components.
The dialogues collected include user requests and bot responses, which are formatted for training purposes, aiding in the development of machine learning models.
